method: MARL-AFM control algorithm applied to EVEnv
scope: fixed shared bid; original market bidding policy is not reproduced
grouping: 3 categories per station, recomputed each step: positive deficit with <=12 remaining steps; other positive deficit; no positive deficit
group_features: mean and maximum EV features, mean executed normalized action, active count
actor: per-station EV-shared MLP, hidden64, two hidden layers, tanh action; own EV, own station public tail, own group summary, centrally computed reference
reference: common interpolation fraction between fleet lower and upper feasible charging powers; reference is actor input, not executed action
critic: one joint attention Q, hidden128, 4 heads, aggregate token pooling
selection: largest GLOBAL+LOCAL at final pilot validation checkpoint, 5 fixed validation episodes; tie chooses smaller factor
selection_dataset: existing validation bank, seed910000; not the final 40 holdout pairs
implementation_assumptions: joint team reward and shared attention critic
